_comment: Edge case: attack_path for CWE-79 (XSS). ATT&CK mappings may be inherited via the CAPEC parent hierarchy (not direct). The offensive agent exposes mapping_type='inherited_via_parent_capec' when the path goes through a parent CAPEC node. This is expected behaviour, not an error. Validated against kgcs-v2, 2026-03 (CHILD_OF edges: 533 in graph).
notes: CWE-79 has no direct CAPEC mapping in many datasets. The CAPEC parent-hierarchy traversal (CAPEC-85 -> CAPEC-580 -> T1082) makes inherited ATT&CK paths visible. Responses with mapping_type='inherited_via_parent_capec' are valid and expected — callers should not treat them as errors. If the ATT&CK STIX bundle has no direct CAPEC cross-references (as in the 2026-03 dataset), IMPLEMENTS edges are sourced exclusively from CAPEC XML taxonomy mappings.
